Method of Attack: Allows users to unenroll an enterprise-managed Chromebook, bypassing device restrictions and forced enrollment by modifying a publicly leaked RMA shim to manage device enrollment, enabling root-level access, USB boot, and other administrative controls.
Impacted Systems: Chromebooks with boards: brask, brya, clapper, coral, dedede, enguarde, glimmer, grunt, hana, hatch, jacuzzi, kukui, nami, octopus, orco, pyro, reks, sentry, stout, strongbad, tidus, ultima, volteer, zork
Indicators of Compromise: Device shows up as inactive in the administration console
Modified RMA shim loaded via Chrome Recovery utility
